description: This PHP source file defines the LeavePeriod class, which is a data transfer object (DTO) in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It encapsulates a leave period with optional start and end dates, providing getter and setter methods, as well as formatted date retrieval functions, and uses traits for date/time helper functions.

classes.name: LeavePeriod
classes.description: A data transfer object representing a leave period with optional start and end DateTime values, including methods for retrieving and setting dates, and formatting them as 'Ymd' strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LeavePeriod with optional start and end DateTime objects.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getYmdStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date formatted as a string in 'Ymd' format.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getYmdEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date formatted as a string in 'Ymd' format.
